prompt: A white-armored customs official in gilded plate stands at the right, arm thrust out palm-forward, pressing a glowing white-gold heraldic wax seal stamp onto the flank of a fleeing beast. The horned grey beast lunges to the left trying to escape but is yanked backward by a taut chain of luminous golden light wrapped around its neck, hauling it off the road toward the viewer-left edge. A bright duty-brand of white-gold light glows where the seal sears its hide. The only strong light is the radiant gold of the seal and the chain. The background is a stone border toll-gate at dusk, a striped barrier arm lowered behind them.
